dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: Provides concrete expert details not usually known by a generic model: exact put‑retention‑policy throttling limits (≈5‑10 req/s), 5‑second eventual‑consistency wait, rounding‑up table for non‑allowed retention values, cost crossover point (~90 days) between CloudWatch and S3, Firehose buffer recommendations (5 MB/300 s), and the default‑first EventBridge strategy. These specifics constitute genuine delta.

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: The skill outlines an AWS‑specific end‑to‑end procedure: inventory, tag‑to‑tier mapping, rate‑limited put‑retention‑policy loop, EventBridge rule creation, Lambda handler with default‑first strategy, daily sweep Lambda, and StackSet rollout. It lacks a concise decision‑tree for IAM permission scoping (least‑privilege policy) which would complete the procedure.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: Lists a thorough NEVER list with concrete reasoning (e.g., never leave log groups at Never Expire, never round retention down, never deploy EventBridge rule without DLQ, never delete a log group to reset retention, never assume tags exist on CreateLogGroup). Only minor omission: no explicit warning about forgetting to update the tag‑map when new environments are added.

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Frontmatter is complete (name, description, version, author, license, compatibility, keywords, tags, metadata, when_to_use, activation_triggers, invocation_schema). The description clearly states WHAT the skill does, WHEN to invoke, and provides reliable activation keywords.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: Uses layered sections and a quick‑navigation table to let the agent dive deeper as needed. The initial Mindset and Critical Rules sections are dense, which adds some cognitive load before the agent reaches the step‑by‑step process.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: Calibrates freedom appropriately: destructive actions (put‑retention‑policy) are gated by a mandatory confirmation prompt, rate‑limiting, and default‑first fallback; creative design steps are left open. Minor gap: IAM role permissions are mentioned only generically, not tightly scoped.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: Follows a recognizable pattern (Mindset → Quick navigation → Critical rules → Pre‑flight → Process steps → Anti‑Patterns → Appendices), aiding comprehension. The pattern is consistent throughout the document.

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: Provides working CLI snippets, Lambda code, error‑handling tables, verification commands, cost estimation, and a full audit checklist, enabling an agent to execute the automation end‑to‑end. Slight deficiency: IAM role trust policy and permission details are not fully fleshed out, requiring the agent to infer or look up additional information.
